positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Ecommerce Applications using Template					    (Sep 2019 – Dec 2019)
Overview:
Worked in a small team to develop and maintain eCommerce applications using WordPress and Open cart templates. Java and MySQL are used in back-end environments. The application features include creating a user account, an admin page to monitor the status of sales, managing products, and users, search/checkout products, filter search results.  

Tasks:
-	Implemented and modified web application templates using Php.
-	Implemented and modified HTML/CSS using bootstrap.
-	Implemented e-commerce plugin (WooCommerce).
-	Implemented payment gateway.
-	Deployed the server on a Linux web server.

Technologies:
	Php, JavaScript, MySQL, HTML5/CSS/Bootstrap, WordPress, Open cart.
